sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Okay, let's get started. This is the Orbit launch sync for Halden Labs.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: First, the beta feedback.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: We got about two hundred responses, and most people love the new calendar view.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: The main complaint is that the invite flow takes too many steps.

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: I looked at the invite flow yesterday, and we can cut it down to two screens.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Great. Rohan, can you ship the shorter invite flow by next Friday?
sentences.label: action

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: Yes, I'll have it ready for review by then.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Next, pricing.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Finance wants to know if we keep the free plan after launch.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: We decided to keep the free plan, with a limit of three calendars.
sentences.label: decision

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: That works for me.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Theo, please send the final pricing page copy to Lena by Tuesday.
sentences.label: action

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Sure, I'll do that.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: On the design side, the onboarding screens still need a final pass.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: I'll update the onboarding screens and post them in the channel tomorrow.
sentences.label: action

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Thanks, Lena.

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: Also, the calendar sync with other providers still drops events about once a week.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Do we know why?

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: It looks like a rate limit on the provider side.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Rohan, please write up the sync bug with logs and share it with the team by Wednesday.
sentences.label: action

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: Understood, I'll add it to the tracker.

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: There is one risk. The push notification service is flaky on older phones.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: How bad is it?

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: About one in twenty notifications fails to arrive.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: That is not acceptable for launch.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Theo, can you ask the vendor for a status report before the 18th?
sentences.label: action

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Okay, I will email them this afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Let's push the public launch from the twentieth to the first of December.
sentences.label: decision

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: That gives us the extra time we need.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Should we tell the beta users about the new date?

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Yes. Lena, write a short announcement and send it to the beta users by the end of the month.
sentences.label: action

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Will do.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: I'll book the launch retro for next week.
sentences.label: action

sentences.speaker: Rohan
sentences.text: One more thing. We should really think about dark mode at some point.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Good idea, but not for this release.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: That's everything. Thanks, all.
